usage.outputShape: body.translated_text (string); also body.source_language, body.detected_source_language, body.formality, body.input_chars, body.output_chars, body.model
usage.guide: Send a POST with JSON {"text": "<text to translate>", "target_language": "<language name, e.g. Spanish>"}. Pay the x402 quote (~$0.01 USDC on Base per short call). Source language is auto-detected; read the translation from body.translated_text. Optional fields like formality may be supported but defaulted to neutral. Plain synchronous response, no auth beyond x402 payment.
